methodology.opponent_adjustment: Iterative regularized two-way offense/defense context model with a three-game prior weight.
methodology.selection: Latest available 2025 leakage-safe pregame snapshot for each team, selected by prior_games and week.
methodology.ranking: Opponent-adjusted effect where available; raw metric otherwise.
